title: 第12章 丈夫和闺蜜的背叛

content_zh:
“你看你，多大人了还咬汤匙！牙齿弄坏！”妈妈姜寰清走了过来，又戳了云画的脑袋，“去接电话，如月打来的。”
云画一愣，就放下了汤匙，一步步走过去接电话。
萧如月，这么快就等不及了？
上辈子也是这样。
她在学小桃林‘幽会’贺御翔被抓，当着那么多人的面被韩军栋辱骂的时候，萧如月把电话打回了家里，问云画回来了没有！
当时是妈妈接的电话，萧如月不知道说了什么之后，妈妈姜寰清就慌了，一个人赶紧沿路去找人。
从家里到学校的一路上，巷子里，到处都找遍了！
最后，她在学校的围墙外面，找到了瑟瑟发抖不敢回家的云画……
紧接着第二天，就是全校通报批评叫家长，原本云画在学校的事情都是姜寰清处理的，可是这一次，由于萧秋慈从中作梗，学校要让“犯事”学生的父母都来学校！
于是就有了当初的那一幕，当着全校师生的面，云画在台上被批判，作检讨，漫长的羞辱之后，迎来的是父亲云从军的毒打！
当初她的父亲云从军在全校师生面前，左右开弓扇了她十几个耳刮子后，拽着她的头发把她一路拖出学校……
云画缓缓地吐了口气，从回忆中醒来。
云画拿起了话筒，已经收拾好了心情。
“月月？怎么这么晚了给我打电话，有事吗？”云画努力想装得跟从前一样天真，可……她真做不到，声音中带上了一点点的僵硬。
不过萧如月大概也听不出来，毕竟萧如月这会儿，肯定很震惊呢！
呵呵，她肯定在想，云画这会儿不应该在小桃林被韩军栋当着那么多同学的面狠狠羞辱么，怎么会回到家了？而且好像什么事情都没发生？
这怎么可能！她明明设计好的！
没错，萧如月这会儿的确非常震惊，可她还要装作什么都没发生一样，套云画的话。
“画画，你什么时候回家的呀？”萧如月的声音很甜很嗲，跟她妈妈萧秋慈一样，天生的娃娃音，不是装的，惹得很多男生都对她的声音情有独钟，整天围在她身边，就为了听她说句话！
“我肚子有些不舒服，没放学就先走了。比平常……可能早了十几分钟到家的吧，怎么了？”云画问道。

电话那端的萧如月沉默了一瞬，才笑着说道，“你手机呢，我打你手机怎么没人接啊。”
云画连忙压低了声音：“嘘，月月你千万别提，我……我手机昨天就掉了，我都不敢跟我妈说，要是被她知道了，还不得骂死我啊！”
“手机掉了？”萧如月的声音陡然尖锐了起来，好像非常吃惊一样。
不过在云画看来，她这是气急败坏！
知道云画手机掉了的话，那么拿到云画手机看到约会短信的人，就肯定不是云画了！
那去了小桃林的人，到底是谁？

content_en:
"Look at how old you are, you're still biting a spoon! You broke your teeth!" Mom Jiang Huanqing came over and poked Yun Hua's head again, "Go and answer the phone, Ru Yue is calling."
Yun Hua was stunned, then put down the spoon and walked over step by step to answer the phone.
Xiao Ruyue, can’t wait so soon?
It was the same in my previous life.
When she was caught having a "tryst" with He Yuxiang in Xiao Taolin, and was insulted by Han Jundong in front of so many people, Xiao Ruyue called home and asked if Yun Hua was back!
It was her mother who answered the call. After Xiao Ruyue didn't know what she said, her mother Jiang Huanqing panicked and hurried along the road to find someone.
On the way from home to school, I searched everywhere in the alleys!
Finally, she found Yun Hua, who was shivering and afraid to go home, outside the school wall...
The very next day, the whole school announced the criticism and called the parents. Originally, Jiang Huanqing handled Yun Hua's affairs at school, but this time, because Xiao Qiuci interfered, the school asked the parents of the "offending" students to come to school!
So there was the original scene. In front of all the teachers and students in the school, Yun Hua was criticized on the stage and made self-examination. After a long period of humiliation, he was beaten severely by his father Yun Congjun!
Back then, her father Yun Congjun slapped her more than a dozen times in front of all the teachers and students in the school, then dragged her out of the school by her hair...
Yun Hua exhaled slowly and woke up from his memories.
Yun Hua picked up the phone and had already calmed down.
"Yueyue? Why are you calling me so late? Are you okay?" Yun Hua tried hard to pretend to be as innocent as before, but... she really couldn't do it, and there was a little stiffness in her voice.
But Xiao Ruyue probably couldn't tell, after all, Xiao Ruyue must be very shocked right now!
Haha, she must be thinking, shouldn't Yun Hua be severely humiliated by Han Jundong in Xiao Taolin in front of so many classmates? Why did he come home? And nothing seems to have happened?
How is this possible! She clearly designed it!
Yes, Xiao Ruyue was indeed very shocked at the moment, but she still wanted to pretend that nothing happened, just like Yun Hua said.
"Huahua, when did you come home?" Xiao Ruyue's voice is very sweet and cooing. Just like her mother Xiao Qiuci, she has a natural baby voice and is not fake. Many boys have a soft spot for her voice and surround her all day long just to hear what she says!
"I felt a little uncomfortable in my stomach, so I left before school. I got home maybe ten minutes earlier than usual. What's wrong?" Yun Hua asked.
Xiao Ruyue on the other end of the phone was silent for a moment, then said with a smile, "Where's your cell phone? Why is no one picking up when I call your cell phone?"
Yun Hua quickly lowered his voice: "Shh, Yueyue, please don't mention it. I... I lost my phone yesterday. I didn't even dare to tell my mother. If she found out, she would scold me to death!"
"Did you drop your phone?" Xiao Ruyue's voice suddenly became sharp, as if she was very surprised.
But from Yun Hua's point of view, she was furious!
If you know that Yun Hua's phone was dropped, then the person who got Yun Hua's phone and saw the date text message must not be Yun Hua!
Who is the person who went to Xiao Taolin?
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
